items.description: Goals allowed per game (MoneyPuck goalsAgainst, shootout goals excluded). Regular-season games for SEASON windows; the L10 window is the team's last 10 games of any type (computed by this export).
known_limitations: Team game logs: PARTIAL (history one-off) / VERIFIED (live kind); the historical parquet pulls are one-off manual-dispatch workflows, not scheduled

raw metrics and DATA_ONLY_V1 ratings are NOT opponent-adjusted (opponent enters the model only as a multiplicative factor at game time); the only opponent-adjusted numbers are the met_nhl.oa_* 5v5 metrics (nhl-oppadj-1.0, RESEARCH)
items.name: Goals against per game

limitations: Team game logs: PARTIAL (history one-off) / VERIFIED (live kind); the historical parquet pulls are one-off manual-dispatch workflows, not scheduled

fixed recent-form windows are not stored by the repository (UNAVAILABLE as stored; RESEARCH as EW weights); L10 here is a plain trailing mean computed by the research export, not a model input
